job.title: Maintenance Millwright
job.description:
Licensed Millwright or Final Year Apprentice 
 
Location: Richmond Hill, ON
Reports to: Maintenance Manager
Industry: Heavy Industrial Manufacturing
Hours: Monday to Friday 6 am - 2:30 pm
  
  
Here's what's in it for you:


  • $46-49/hour
  • Profit sharing
  • Overtime available
  • Employer-paid benefits
  • 4% RRSP matching
 
Additional perks:


  • All PPE and tools provided
  • Incredibly stable company with substantial investment in maintenance technology / equipment equating to exciting projects that this person will be involved with.
  • Opportunities for career advancement and an incredible Manager who is a strong mentor and eager to grow his team in their technical and leadership skills.

 
Here's what you will do:
 


  • Work daily with CMMS software to create, modify, and close work orders
  • Read blueprints, diagrams and schematic drawings to determine work procedures
  • Install, align, dismantle and move stationary industrial machinery and mechanical equipment, such as pumps, fans, tanks, conveyors, furnaces and generators according to layout plans using hand and power tools
  • Operate hoisting and lifting devices such as cranes, jacks and tractors to position machinery and parts during the installation, set-up and repair of machinery
  • Inspect and examine machinery and equipment to detect and investigate irregularities and malfunctions.
  • Install, troubleshoot and maintain power transmission, vacuum, hydraulic and pneumatic systems, and mechanical logic controls
  • Adjust machinery and repair or replace defective parts
  • Operate machine tools such as lathes and grinders to fabricate parts required during overhaul, maintenance or set-up of machinery
  • Clean, lubricate and perform other routine maintenance work on machinery
  • Assemble machinery and equipment prior to installation using hand and power tools and welding equipment
  • May perform other tasks as deemed appropriate
 
Here's what we're looking for and what you will need to succeed:
 


  • 5+ years of hands-on Maintenance experience in a high-volume manufacturing environment
  • 433A Licensed Millwright or 4th Year Apprentice. Red Seal Millwright is an advantage.
  • Forklift license or experience with willingness to become certified
  • Overhead Crane Operator license or experience with willingness to become certified
  • Experience troubleshooting and repairing industrial machinery including basic skills with PLC troubleshooting
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints/drawings
  • Strong problem solving and critical thinking skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and evolving environment
  • Strong oral and written communication and teamwork skills
  • Ability to work in a physically demanding environment (lifting, moving materials, going up ladders, crouching, etc.)
  • Ability and willingness to learn, curiosity, positive attitude and commitment to getting the job done right in a timely manner
  • Reliable and committed with good attendance record
  • Computer proficient: MS Office, CMMS
  • High regard for health and safety and commitment to always following company and safety policies and procedures
  • Excellent attention to detail, highly organized, and strong multi-tasking abilities
  • Experience using a variety of hand and power tools. Welding or fabrication experience is an asset.
  • Capable of working in heights, and confined spaces
